evidence: The Configure page's "Enable stage" switches for the ring removal, the punch and the backfill reached the backend only as stages left out of stages: enabledStages (web/src/state/pipelineStore.ts:320-332) left them out, its comment saying the backend passes the input through, and formToParams (:336-337) sent no switch; the server's StageParamsIn (src/nebula3d/server/schemas.py:380) had none, the request's flatten_enabled (:486) the only one. run_pipeline reads a stage left out as a partial re-run: its stage_input (src/nebula3d/pipeline.py:2212-2231) passed only the flatten through without looking (_switched_off, :2203-2207) and took the other stages' outputs an earlier run had left on disk. Measured on the dev rings case at 121³, each switch sent as the page sent it, with Force on, after a run with every stage on: with the ring removal off, the punch read the old ring-removed volume, its output the all-on run's bit for bit, where a fresh rings-off run's punched volume differs in 98,449 voxels by up to 0.52 and its mask in 3,578; with the punch off, the backfill read the old punched volume (off a fresh punch-off run's backfilled volume by up to 117.7 in 22,668 voxels, the ΔPDF by up to 1,502 where its largest |value| is 3,692); with the backfill off, the flatten read the old backfilled volume (the ΔPDF off by up to 59.7 of 3,844). The browser's WebGPU ΔPDF took PipelinePaths.pdf_input, or a tuning trial's inputs["backfill"] with the flatten off (src/nebula3d/webbridge.py:914-919): with the backfill off too, a backfilled volume an earlier run left. A tuning trial reads the stages before its run's first one from processed/ (src/nebula3d/server/tuning.py:175, :216-220), so a trial after a switched-off stage read that stage's old output. Found by B1 (6233134), which fixed the flatten's switch alone.
proposed_fix: A switch per cleanup stage, as the flatten has: PipelineParams.rings_enabled, punch_enabled and backfill_enabled, sent by the page with every run in StageParamsIn (formToParams sends all three) and read by the server's build_params and by the in-browser bridge from params_json. A stage switched off is not run, even when listed, and passes its input through, B1's rule: the next stage reads what came before it, never an output an earlier run left, in processed/ or among a tuning trial's inputs (one function, _stage_input, which the WebGPU ΔPDF path shares); PipelinePaths.pdf_input names the last stage switched on, and ring_stage_pending is false for a switched-off ring stage. The stage's own output file is neither written nor removed, as with the flatten. The log names the volume the stage after it reads ("ring removal disabled: the Bragg punch reads …"), and a switched-off stage that is listed says it is off. A stage left out of stages with its switch on keeps its meaning, a partial re-run (the Pilot's runs from a stage, the tuning's trials, the browser's ring fan-out). The page keeps stages for what to run, and its comment says what the switches do.
tests: tests/test_stage_switches.py::test_a_stage_switched_off_after_a_run_equals_a_fresh_run_with_it_off (dev rings at 121³, each of the three switches after a run with every stage on: the stage after it reads what came before it and says so, every artifact equals a fresh run with the switch off bit for bit, the old output is left as it was)

tests/test_stage_switches.py::test_a_stage_left_out_still_reads_the_stored_output (the ring removal left out with its switch on: the stored volume read, the all-on run's outputs bit for bit; a tuning trial's inputs)
tests/test_pipeline_orchestration.py::test_a_stage_switched_off_passes_its_input_through (each switch, the stage left out of stages or listed)
web/src/state/__tests__/pipelineStore.test.ts (formToParams sends each switch; a run sends the stages switched on, with the switches)
note: Approved by the manager on the user's delegation, 2026-10-19. Against the pre-fix code (0c08607), on dev rings at 121³ and the 61³ demo: every artifact of a run with every stage on, of a fresh run with a stage off (the ring removal, the punch or the backfill; the flatten from scratch, and after a run with it on), and of a run with the ring removal left out after a full run is bit-identical (the ring diagnostics differ only in their timings); a run gains log lines only where a stage is switched off. Arm A on dev re-run: 32 of 32 entries identical, 5 of 8 cases pass, as recorded, its 24 run logs unchanged (arm A runs with every stage on). The model-visible text is unchanged: no snapshot moved, the switches being page settings outside the tuning's catalog. The ΔPDF's switch (pdfEnabled) has no such problem: the stage is last, nothing reads its output, and its check rides with it. Left: a run with Force off keeps the outputs that exist, as for any setting, so switching a stage off and running without Force recomputes nothing after it (the outputs record no switches); with the ΔPDF off while the stages before it are re-run with Force, switching it back on without Force keeps the old ΔPDF and check, which the stale guard (its input's name and the transform's settings) finds current; and the views that pair a stage with the one before it (the shell floors' input, the texture check's punched stage) assume every stage on.

decision.by: the manager, on the user's delegation
decision.option: a switch per stage, sent by the page; a stage switched off passes its input through; a stage left out of stages stays a partial re-run
